Hiring a part-time external communications consultant for an August-to-September engagement to build a donor-facing external communications strategy and produce the core collateral: storytelling content, e-newsletter program reset (editorial cadence, drafting, scheduling), social collateral, and content for A/B testing and new-audience acquisition. Explicitly asks for hands-on LinkedIn content management for organizational and executive presence.

fitDetails.buyer_quality: +5 — defined immediate need with a fixed budget and a named window

Executive LinkedIn presence work is a thought-leadership wedge
Newsletter program reset is a clean, self-contained first deliverable
leads.source: Idealist — External Communications & Digital Strategy Consultant, Touch Health Inc (posted 2026-08-16)
leads.notes: Grade A (combined 80) on the rubric, but read the grade with a caveat: the score is driven almost entirely by intent (recency, part-time, clear budget, easy apply), not by fit. Sector is nonprofit global health rather than Mark's finance/PE/B2B core, the remit is donor content and owned channels rather than earned media, and $7,500 for a two-month part-time engagement is below senior-operator rates. CAVEAT: Idealist pages are JavaScript-rendered and returned an empty body on direct fetch — posting details are corroborated from indexed search results, so verify scope and budget on the live listing before investing time. ACTION: worth a fast, low-effort application given the freshness and defined scope; pitch the executive-visibility and narrative angle rather than competing on content-production price.
